title: SOS bounded execution actor input (skeleton — PUB-03)
description: The bounded job input the Render API dispatches to this actor (directive §9; contract §D PUB-08). The actor never decides authorization — it executes exactly this authorized, bounded request and reports truthfully. Every field is bounded: an input that exceeds a limit is rejected before any work runs (fail-closed).

jobId.description: The durable Job id (directive §8) this run belongs to.

tenantId.description: Tenant (workspace) that owns the job — used for artifact key scoping only, never for authorization decisions.

authorizedAction.description: The exact action the SOS authority layer authorized (authorization snapshot lives in the Job record). The actor MUST NOT execute anything beyond it.

kind.description: Immutable source reference kind. 'latest main' style mutable refs are forbidden (security gate S11).

revision.description: Exact 40-hex commit SHA (S11: exact source revision recording).

sourceRevision.description: The EXACT immutable source revision the operation is bounded to.

allowedOperation.description: The single allowed operation for this run. Anything else the input asks for is refused.

timeLimitSeconds.description: Wall-clock bound for the whole run (security gate S14).

limits.description: Resource bounds (S14). The run aborts FAILED when exceeded — never reports success.

url.description: The signed provider-callback endpoint on the Render API.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 emission time for the timestamp window (S10).

signature.description: HMAC signature of the callback envelope (S10: validated BEFORE any state mutation on the API side).

callbackTarget.description: Where the execution receipt is delivered. The actor cannot authorize itself (S12): the callback is proof of execution, never proof of authority.

requestHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request — the actor echoes it in the receipt so the API can verify the run matched the dispatched job exactly.

artifactPolicy.description: Whether output artifacts are uploaded (pre-signed R2 URLs provided by the dispatcher in PUB-08) or the receipt carries inline results only.
